scope: Real unforked owned Anvil, deployed production contracts, genuine transactions, BE03/BE04/BE05/BE07, actual CLI worker, loopback HTTP. Not testnet, remote-client, or browser performance.

method.model: Ten closed-loop HTTP clients, one outstanding request each, no think time or request retries; starts stop after at least 60s and completion of ten concurrent freshness samples; in-flight requests drain. Client, API and PostgreSQL are loopback; client/API share one Node process, worker is a separate CLI process.
method.extraRoutes: Health measured separately (100 sequential reads), excluded from data percentiles. Data reads pin the baseline H/hash snapshot; event probes use latest transfers and verify the new publication.
method.latency: Monotonic performance.now(), immediately before fetch through complete JSON body consumption; semantic validation occurs afterward.
method.percentile: Exact nearest-rank: sorted successful request latencies at ceil(0.95*N)-1. Errors reported separately and any error fails acceptance.
method.threshold: Global and each timed endpoint successful p95 strictly <1000ms, zero errors, exact 100 proposals/1000 indexed votes.
method.timestampControl: LOCAL Anvil anvil_setBlockTimestampInterval(0), explicit identical timestamp per transaction, every receipt header checked; no production config changed.
method.accountPolicy: Standard ten unlocked Anvil accounts (no keys or impersonation); each holds and self-delegates 100 GOV. Historical Q-PERF named Y is replaced by the tenth standard account.

freshness.timing: Conservative upper bound: monotonic clock immediately BEFORE mining the second following block, through a complete HTTP body containing this transaction, with SQL publication H/hash equal to API H/hash. Mining acknowledgement is the eligibility upper bound. 25ms polling adds observation delay.
freshness.scope: Owned Anvil, real CLI worker, 100 proposals/1000 votes; no production/testnet SLA. Outage is excluded from normal-RPC samples.

dataset.countsSql:
SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM proposals WHERE deployment_id=$1)::text AS proposals,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM votes WHERE deployment_id=$1)::text AS votes,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM proposal_states WHERE deployment_id=$1 AND state='Succeeded')::text AS succeeded,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM transfers WHERE deployment_id=$1)::text AS transfers,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM raw_events WHERE deployment_id=$1 AND event_name='ProposalCreated')::text AS raw_proposals,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM raw_events WHERE deployment_id=$1 AND event_name='VoteCast')::text AS raw_votes
